name: Cacophony Hound
body:
Cacophony Hound CR 2

XP 600
N Medium magical beast
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 20 (2d10+9)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d6+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks barking causes confusion

STATISTICS

Str 19; Dex 12; Con 17; Int 1; Wis 12; Cha 2
Base Atk +1; CMB +6; CMD 17
Feats Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth)
Skills Perception +8, Stealth +5

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

Lesser confusion (DC 9) by barking, as an attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment any plains or forest
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (3–6)
Treasure none

The cacophony hound stands out as a curious beast. These hounds sport a pair of vestigial wings, and packs of them stalk grasslands and forests hunting for food.

The barking of a cacophony hound has the same effect as lesser confusion towards one target. Cacophony hounds will typically only attack if the number of cacophony hounds is much larger the number of targets: this allows some hounds to confuse the targets, while the other hounds will attack. If attacked by vastly superior numbers, cacophony hounds will typically flee, as they possess a form of rudimentary cunning.

Cacophony hounds are very wolf- or feral dog-like, and raise their offspring in a litter. When a hound reaches maturity, it will often split off from the pack and seek out territory of its own. The hunting grounds for a pack of cacophony hounds can be upwards of 10 square miles.

Cacophony hounds have dark colored pelts and wings, and are typically 3 feet long and weight 40 pounds when fully grown.
